title: Why the Kai Tak approach is so demanding
dek: One straight leg, a 47-degree turn low over Kowloon City, hills on one side and a runway that ends in the bay.
description: The IGS 13 approach at Kai Tak: start at 3,100 ft, fly to the checkerboard, make a 47° right turn at 650 ft and land on a runway that ends in the bay.
hero_alt: A 747 halfway through the checkerboard turn, with the orange-and-white checkerboard on the hill to the left.
hero_caption: Halfway round the turn, with the checkerboard off the left wing.
card_title: Why the approach is so demanding

zh.title: 點解啟德進場咁有挑戰性
zh.dek: 一段直線、九龍城上空低飛 47° 轉彎、一邊係山、跑道盡頭係海灣。
zh.description: 啟德 IGS 13 進場：3,100 呎開始，向棋盤飛，650 呎右轉 47°，降落喺盡頭係海灣嘅跑道。
zh.hero_alt: 一架 747 轉到一半，橙白相間嘅棋盤喺左邊山上。
zh.hero_caption: 轉到一半，棋盤喺左翼外面。
